name: close the loop from game play records to retrained strategy dies
asks: The self-teaching game AI is a circuit of existing dies plus two missing ones. Existing: aagaard's per-game adapters, the Lean-verified Splinterlands strategy recommendation, the RWIL witness pipeline, the inference-work-lot market for cheap analysis. Missing: (1) a match-play die per game that actually queues and plays under a bounded budget, and (2) a strategy-refinement die that consumes the witnessed play records, contracts cheap inference to propose strategy revisions, re-proves the safety envelope in Lean, and redeploys. Each game lane then improves itself on a timer, and the Lean gate is what makes autonomous redeployment governable rather than reckless.
